messages:
maria: Design review — thinking about a 'structured response lane' in the playground run history. Each tool call gets its own vertical lane (header with fn name + schema badge, collapsible output, quick actions). Mockups attached. Thoughts on accessibility + header copy? alex: Sketch looks promising. Two quick concerns: keyboard navigation between lanes, and screenreader labeling for the lane header. maria: @alex yep — plan is left/right arrow to move lanes, Enter/Space to toggle collapse. Header will have an id and lane will use aria-labelledby. Also need concise header copy — 'Tool: fetch_user_profile' feels wordy. sam: I like shorter headers: 'fetch_user_profile() · 200ms' or just 'fetch_user_profile · 200ms'. Also add a small badge for 'structured' vs 'text' so users know result type at a glance. zoe: Copy nit: 'Output' is a bit vague. Prefer 'Result' or 'Tool result'. My vote: use 'Result' — it reads better in collapsed summaries. When collapsed, show a single summary line + status icon. dinesh: Accessibility notes: collapse toggle must be a real
``` alex: :thumbsup: I'll check keyboard mapping and add unit + e2e tests for focus order. sam: I'll draft header copy variations this afternoon — aim for <= 30 chars for localization. zoe: :eyes: I'll review collapsed summary phrasing and length for German/JA. dinesh: Suggestion: include a 'Copy JSON' quick action in the header. Ensure it announces 'JSON copied to clipboard' on success. Keyboard shortcut + visible tooltip. maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll push updated frames to Figma and ping this thread when ready for another pass. ui-bot: Deploy checklist: add keyboard + a11y tests, update i18n strings, verify live-region announcements in SR sessions.
